name: start_member
title: Start a member on work without a card
description: Start an AI member on work without a card, on your own authority (an owner request only under owner_request) or on a signal_id: the text goes to their general conversation (a running one gets it when its turn ends). Waits up to 5 seconds and says what became of the start. For a card use start_task.

despite_workers.description: A start on a card where a member of the same role already works is not sent (the result names them); true sends it anyway, only for intended parallel work.

task_key.description: The card the text is about; the member needs a role on it (the card's merger or its step owner).

signal_id.description: Without an owner request, when the project lets you act on signals: starts the member the signal names.

annotations.title: Start a member on work without a card
